title: •Yoda, Master Of The Force
caption: •Yoda, Master of the Force (V)
game_text: Deploys only to battlegrounds. Power +3 in defensive battles. You may not deploy {episode1} Jedi. While with a Wookiee, adds one battle destiny. Once per game, may lose 2 Force from Force Pile to cancel a non-{sense} Interrupt. Immune to attrition.
lore: *Jedi Council member*. “More to say have you?”
copyright: © 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 7 / JEDI MASTER (label only); deploy 5 / forfeit 7 (printed 4/7). Icon column: warrior (blue box, blaster) — the printed card has no column icons. Inline: black 'EPISODE I' circle → {episode1}; red circle-slash S (the slash crossing the S makes it look like an 8 at this size; stub confirms 'non-(Immune to Sense)') → {sense}. CREDITS printed horizontally in italics under the text box: left 'Original concept by Steven Lewis', right 'Tennessee States 2006' → credit_bottom (as vs13/07). TITLE: printed card reads 'Yoda, Master Of The Force' (capital O/T); the slip's heading and caption print 'Master of the Force' — title = printed, caption as slip. Light Jedi Master disc (blue blade) top-left on the printed card → affiliation 'Jedi Master', disc 'jedi-light' (as vs5 Yoda / vs12 Yoda, Senior Council Member). Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes “More to say have you?” (wiki straight single quotes); 'Jedi Council member' prints visibly heavier than the quote on the 745 px V13 remake → *bold*. Base scan only 350 px; copyright '© 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.' legible on the V13 remake. Modern: V13-L-yodamasteroftheforce.gif (745 px) is the PC's later Virtual Set 13 Yoda, Master Of The Force (different text, 'Original concept by The KToD'); same art/lore — art backport only. No V14 remake of this slip found. Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
